name: qlrisk_price_credit_default_swap
title: Price a CreditDefaultSwap
description: Price one qlrisk CreditDefaultSwap (Credit Default Swap; credit, credit): NPV in the trade currency and the reporting currency, pricing components, analytic Greeks where the pricer gives them, and optional cash flows. Inputs are this product's fields only; required: notional (maturity_date or tenor_years); pricer terms: coupon, is_buyer, recovery, reference. Market data defaults to qlrisk's sample snapshot valued today; override curves, spots and vols, or apply shocks, with market_data as in qlrisk_price_trades. For a book of several products use qlrisk_price_trades. Example: {"notional": 1000000, "tenor_years": 5, "coupon": 0.05}.
